findings.current: The weapons they fired were barely effective against low-level monsters.
findings.defect: The draft says the weapons have only limited effectiveness against low-level monsters, while the source says low-level monsters are the only ones they affect at all.
findings.rationale: The restrictive cue 만 preserves the mechanical distinction between weapons working on low-level monsters and having no effect on stronger ones.
findings.replacement: The weapons they fired were effective only against low-level monsters at best.
findings.source: 그들이 발사한 화기는 고작해야 하급 몬스터들에게만 통하는 수준이었다.

findings.current:
Leading the way were Wyverns, known as the terrors of the sky, followed by dozens of Griffons and Gargoyles.

The A-rank monsters folded their wings at an angle and descended, swooping down upon the fighter jets that had not yet managed to take off.
findings.defect: The draft changes the single leading Wyvern into multiple Wyverns and omits that the descending monsters' wings span several meters.
findings.rationale: The singular 와이번 is the specific creature leading the formation, while 수 미터 explicitly describes the size of the attackers' wings.
findings.replacement:
A Wyvern, known as the terror of the skies, led the way, followed by dozens of Griffons and Gargoyles.

The A-rank monsters angled their several-meter-long wings and dove upon the fighter jets that had not yet managed to take off.
findings.source:
창공의 공포라 불리는 와이번을 선두로 수십 마리의 그리폰(Griffon), 가고일(Gargoyle)이 뒤따른다.

수 미터의 날개를 비스듬히 꺾으며 하강한 A급 몬스터들이 아직 미처 이륙하지 못한 전투기들을 덮쳤다.

findings.current: Arrows saturated with all kinds of magic and mana pierced the Griffon.
findings.defect: The draft collapses two distinct attacks—various spells and mana-laden arrows—into arrows containing different kinds of magic.
findings.rationale: The coordination joins 가지각색의 마법 with 마나를 한껏 머금은 화살, so both spells and arrows strike the Griffon.
findings.replacement: All manner of spells and arrows brimming with mana pierced the Griffon.
findings.source: 가지각색의 마법과 마나를 한껏 머금은 화살이 그리폰을 꿰뚫었다.

findings.current: It could not compare to the power of mana, which was the natural opposite of the monsters’ own mana, but the concentrated firepower forced even the flying monsters to hesitate.
findings.defect: By rendering both 마나 and the monsters' 마력 as “mana,” the draft nonsensically states that mana is the natural opposite of itself and obscures the stated counter relationship.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly distinguishes Hunter mana from the monsters' magical power and explains that the former counters the latter.
findings.replacement: Though modern weapons could not compare to mana—the natural counter to the monsters’ magical power—concentrating their firepower all at once forced even the flying monsters to hesitate.
findings.source: 비록 몬스터들의 마력과 상극이라 할 수 있는 마나(Mana)의 힘에 비할 바는 아니지만, 일거에 화력을 집중시키니 비행 몬스터들도 주춤할 수밖에 없었다.

findings.current: Poison Breath fired by a Green Wyvern covered a radius of more than a hundred meters, and the divisional commander and the staff command were melted beneath the powerful acidic venom.
findings.defect: “The staff command” is not natural English, and “melted beneath” blurs the explicit sequence in which the command staff are drenched in acid and then melt.
findings.rationale: 참모 지휘부 means the command staff, while 뒤집어쓴 채 explicitly depicts them covered in the acidic poison as they melt.
findings.replacement: The Poison Breath fired by a Green Wyvern blanketed an area over a hundred meters in radius, and the divisional commander and his command staff were drenched in the powerful acidic poison and melted away.
findings.source: 그린 와이번이 쏘아 보낸 포이즌 브레스(Poison Breath)가 반경 백여 미터를 뒤덮었고, 사단장을 포함한 참모 지휘부는 강력한 산성 독을 뒤집어쓴 채 녹아내렸다.

findings.current: An army of white bones gained new life and slowly rose from pools of death.
findings.defect: “An army of white bones” is an unnatural literal rendering of 백골 and suggests disembodied bones rather than reanimated skeletons.
findings.rationale: In this undead context, 백골의 군단 naturally denotes an army of skeletons.
findings.replacement: An army of skeletons gained new life and slowly rose from pools of death.
findings.source: 새로운 생명을 얻고 죽음의 웅덩이에서 서서히 몸을 일으키는 백골(白骨)의 군단.

findings.current: But that would never happen again. Not in the past, and not in the future.
findings.defect: “Again” implies that Yao Wei had previously succeeded in getting Shao Shen to pay, contradicting the following statement that it had never happened in the past.
findings.rationale: The source states symmetrically that such a victory occurred neither in the past nor would occur in the future.
findings.replacement: But that had never happened before, and it never would.
findings.source: 하지만 그런 일은 과거에도, 앞으로도 없을 것이다.

findings.current: The Hunters who had entered the battle prepared to die now faced something more frightening for the first time: human feeling.
findings.defect: “Human feeling” is overly broad and unnatural, obscuring that the Hunters are shaken by personal affection and attachment to comrades resurrected as enemies.
findings.rationale: 인정 here means humane affection or personal bonds, specifically the comradeship that makes fighting the undead emotionally difficult.
findings.replacement: The Hunters who had entered battle prepared to die now faced a new kind of fear for the first time: their attachment to one another.
findings.source: 죽을 각오로 전투에 임하던 헌터들은 처음으로 인정(人情)이라는 두려움에 직면했다.

findings.defect: The draft turns a deliberate declaration that the speaker will ram something into an accidental or uncontrolled crash, altering the intent behind the culminating action.
findings.rationale: 박는다 announces an intentional ramming action, while the omitted object is preserved by Shao Shen's immediate question asking what will be rammed.
findings.replacement:
“I’m going to ram it!”

Ram what?

summary: The draft contains one critical alteration to the climactic action, along with several meaningful errors in monster quantity, combat mechanics, and characterization.
